verdict.rationale: Grafana ships an official MCP Server (cloud-hosted and open-source) letting AI agents connect and operate Grafana, and markets 'understand production systems faster using natural language' plus AI-driven investigation via Sift. However, evidence is vendor-documentation only with no independent/hands-on validation of how comprehensive or reliable natural-language command coverage is across dashboards, alerting, and admin tasks. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on evidence of NL command breadth and reliability, and any community confirmation of MCP server usage in practice.
